text:
I can see that you're feeling really frustrated and undervalued after the argument with your classmate. It's completely understandable to feel that way, especially when your ideas are dismissed without any consideration.

In situations like this, it can be really helpful to remember that your contributions are valuable, even if they're not being recognized right now. It might be worth taking a step back and reminding yourself of all the great ideas you've brought to the table so far in the project. Sometimes, when we're feeling overwhelmed, it's hard to see the bigger picture, but your ideas are still important and worth sharing.

If you feel comfortable, could you tell me more about what specifically made you feel invisible and undervalued during the argument? Was it the way your classmate spoke to you, or the fact that they didn't even consider your ideas? Sometimes, breaking down what happened can help us understand why we're feeling a certain way and find ways to move forward.
